title: Linux Basics
subtitle: Start at the prompt
description: The command line, from zero. Learn how the shell actually works, how to move around a filesystem, and how to read the permissions and processes that everything else in Linux is built on.

lessons.title: What Is a Shell?
lessons.summary: What you're actually talking to when you open a terminal.

lessons.title: Navigating the Filesystem
lessons.summary: pwd, ls, and cd — and the tree they move you through.

lessons.title: Files and Directories
lessons.summary: Creating, copying, moving, and deleting things without regret.

lessons.title: Reading and Editing Files
lessons.summary: cat, less, and surviving your first encounter with vim.

lessons.title: Permissions
lessons.summary: Why 'Permission denied' happens, and what rwx and chmod 644 really mean.

lessons.title: Processes
lessons.summary: Every running thing has a number. Find it, watch it, stop it.

lessons.title: Pipes and Redirection
lessons.summary: The idea that makes the whole command line worth learning.
